page.overview:
Who is Redwolf?

Redwolf is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates.

Redwolf is a fair-skinned man with blonde hair, a square jaw and a cleft mouth. He wears frilled shoulder pads with a furred cape, a leather vest, a pair of dark brown gloves, gray pants with a belt, and boots. Due to eating a Wolf SMILE, he has a red-furred wolf protruding out of his belly. As a Gifter, he wears a pair of black horns.

Redwolf appears to be quite ambitious, wanting to be elevated to the position of Tobiroppo, and was willing to throw himself into battle to achieve his goals. This is more explicit in the anime, where he yells that he intends to claim the position himself.

As a Gifter, Redwolf has consumed a |Ōkami no Sumairu}}, giving him a wolf protruding out of his torso.
